labels.name: upstream
labels.rationale: Dependency advisory about Pygments, not a Rich defect

body:
This report is about a vulnerability advisory for the Pygments dependency, not a defect in Rich itself. Rich's dependency range is managed in `pyproject.toml`, and the project's vulnerability reporting process is described in [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/SECURITY.md); please use that for private reports.

A similar advisory report was filed earlier as #4044, and that thread is a related reference.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
